options.text: To announce that judges will now favor phone-recorded entries

explanation.summary_zh: 郵件最後一段依序提到四件事。第一，三月會員早餐會上，幾位業主表示會猶豫是否為其他類別提交影片，因為他們以為評審會偏好專業拍攝的作品。第二，Ama Okafor 的新秀獎參賽作品，是她自己用借來的手機錄製的麵包店簡單導覽。第三，在頒獎晚宴上，她的麵包店獲得新秀獎。第四，Helen 建議邀請她在九月說明會上對潛在參賽者演講。綜合這些線索，Helen 最可能是想讓大家看到：得獎影片不一定要專業拍攝。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Helen 沒有直接寫出邀請的理由，需要結合不同句子的線索推論。①業主的顧慮：他們猶豫是否提交影片，assuming 表示「以為評審偏好專業拍攝」只是業主的假設。②錄製句只說明這份新秀獎參賽作品的製作方式：Okafor 自己用借來的手機錄製簡單導覽，本句沒有提到評選結果。③得獎句只說她的麵包店在頒獎晚宴上獲得新秀獎，沒有提到拍攝方式。her 與 Newcomer 連回上一句的 her Newcomer entry，可知獲獎的參賽作品就是那支她自己錄製的簡單導覽影片。④說明會的對象是潛在參賽者，正是可能有同樣顧慮的人。錄製句與得獎句各提供一項前提，合起來才表示一支並非專業拍攝的影片得了獎。再對照業主的顧慮與演講對象，就能推出 C。這裡的重點不是手機一定拍不出專業品質，而是這位參賽者本人用借來的手機錄了一段簡單導覽，並非專業拍攝。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件確實提到 Sanjay 接聽了所有尋求上傳協助的來電，但郵件並未把這些來電與 Okafor 連結起來。緊接在邀請前描述的顧慮是拍攝方式，也就是業主以為評審偏好專業拍攝，而不是上傳有困難。郵件只說她自己用借來的手機錄製影片，沒有提到她上傳的情形，也沒有說要她示範上傳步驟。A 把錄製方式的線索誤連到上傳協助。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件用 assuming 表示「評審偏好專業拍攝」只是業主的假設，並沒有說評審實際上有這種偏好。Okafor 是得獎者而非評審，而且她自己錄製的簡單導覽得了獎；請她解釋評審為何偏好專業拍攝，與這個例子在文中的作用不符。B 把業主的假設當成了事實。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。業主因以為評審偏好專業拍攝而猶豫；Okafor 的參賽作品是她自己用借來的手機錄製的簡單導覽，之後她的麵包店在晚宴上獲得新秀獎。邀請她對潛在參賽者演講，正好可以回應這項顧慮，說明得獎影片不一定要專業拍攝。C 並不表示評審偏好手機錄製的作品。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Okafor 的例子只說明非專業拍攝的影片也能得獎。郵件沒有說評審今後會偏好手機錄製的作品，也沒有提到評選標準有任何改變。D 把「不必專業拍攝也能得獎」誇大成「評審將偏好手機錄製」，超出原文能支持的範圍。

evidence.quote: At the March members' breakfast, several owners said they would hesitate to submit videos for other categories, assuming the judges would favor professionally filmed entries.
For her Newcomer entry, Ama Okafor recorded a simple tour of her bakery herself, using a borrowed phone.
At the awards dinner, her bakery won the Newcomer Award.
I suggest inviting her to speak at our September information session for prospective entrants.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動機推論題的線索常分散在不同句子。可先找出作者描述的顧慮，再分別找出相關人物的做法與後來的結果，最後看建議的場合與對象，確認這項建議如何回應顧慮。干擾選項常把假設當成事實、把線索連到無關的事項，或把「不必如此」誇大成「偏好相反的做法」。

content.title: Moving a Growing Animation Studio
content.scenario_summary: A moving company's news page profiles Lanternfish Studio, a small animation studio. Its award-winning short film led to a TV series order and a move to larger premises. The page lists the tasks Ridgeway's own staff will perform: loading on Saturday, placing each numbered crate at the matching desk, and connecting and testing computers on Sunday. It notes that the building's owner is separately having wall shelves put up. It also quotes the studio owner insisting that the corner room be set aside for quiet work, with no phones and no meetings. In a later four-star review, the owner opens by saying that last week she booked Ridgeway for a June job: bringing archive boxes from storage and unpacking them onto the studio's shelves. Turning to the April move, she praises the planning visit, the Saturday crew and its leader, and the working computers. She also reports two unattributed Monday problems: crates stacked by the elevator and shelves still boxed. Her team lost an hour sorting the crates, and she says that lost hour is why she deducted one star. She adds that the two senior animators work in the open studio beside the new animators, and that the corner room is where the studio holds its weekly calls with the TV channel. She does not say what the room was planned for. The questions test five points. The first compares a promise with experience: crate placement is the only Ridgeway task with a reported discrepancy, because the shelves were the building owner's arrangement. The second tests 'drawn up' meaning prepared. The third joins the crate complaint in the review's second paragraph with the scope of the June booking in its first paragraph to infer that she still trusts Ridgeway to put things in place despite the crate problem. Its rivals are that she will have her own staff do the unpacking (grounded in her team sorting the crates but ruled out by the June job's unpacking), that she had no complaints about the April move (consistent with the booking and praise but ruled out by the crate complaint and star deduction), and that she blames the crate problem on poor planning (unsupported, since she calls the planning visit thorough). The fourth asks for the crew leader's identity against a technician rival. The fifth joins the owner's stated wish on the web page for a phone-free, meeting-free corner room with the review's report that the room is used for weekly calls.

blocks.text: Helping a Local Success Story Grow
Posted: March 24

Two years ago, Lanternfish Studio was just its owner, Noor Haddad, and two animators sharing a room above Park Pharmacy. Then its short film about the old harbor ferry won the audience award at the Lakeport Film Festival, and a children's television channel ordered a twelve-episode series. With six new animators starting in April, the studio has run out of space. On Saturday, April 12, our crew will move it to the third floor of the Dockside Building.

Our move coordinator, Della Moreno, has visited both sites and drawn up a floor plan with Ms. Haddad. Most of the new space will be one open studio, but Ms. Haddad insisted that the corner room be set aside for quiet work: no phones, no meetings. "Animators need somewhere to concentrate," she said.

As on every Ridgeway move, each Lanternfish employee will pack numbered crates, and our crew will place every crate at the desk with the matching number. On Sunday afternoon, our technicians will connect and test the studio's computers. The Dockside Building's owner, meanwhile, is having new wall shelves put up before moving day.
Planning a move of your own? Book a free planning visit at ridgewaymoves.example.
Ridgeway Office Moves
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
Reviewer: Noor Haddad, Lanternfish Studio | May 2

Last week I booked Ridgeway for a second job: in June, they will bring our archive boxes from storage and unpack them onto our shelves. For our April move, Della Moreno's planning visit was thorough, and the Saturday crew had everything loaded by noon. Sam Ortiz, who led that crew, even came back on Sunday afternoon to let the technicians in. On Monday morning, every computer was connected and running.

The rest of that morning was less smooth. Our crates were all stacked by the elevator, and the wall shelves were still boxed in the corridor. With our first episode due that week, we lost an hour sorting crates ourselves. That lost hour is why I've taken off one star.

Best of all is how my team uses the new space. Our senior animators, Ama and Joel, work in the open studio beside the six new animators, who turn to them with questions all day. The studio has never felt livelier, and the corner room is where we hold our weekly calls with the TV channel.

questions.prompt: Which task that Ridgeway said its own staff would carry out did not go as described?

options.label: A
options.text: Loading the studio's belongings on Saturday

options.label: B
options.text: Connecting and testing the computers on Sunday

options.label: C
options.text: Placing each crate at the matching desk

options.label: D
options.text: Putting up the new wall shelves before moving day

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁說 Ridgeway 的搬運人員會把每個箱子放到號碼相符的桌子旁，評論卻說週一早上箱子全堆在電梯旁。這是 Ridgeway 說由自家人員負責、評論又明確呈現與說法不符的工作，所以選 (C)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 評論提到週一早上有兩個問題：箱子全堆在電梯旁，牆面層架也還裝在箱子裡、放在走廊。評論沒有說明這兩件事各由誰負責，也沒有列出 Ridgeway 原本說自家人員要做哪些事，所以只看評論，無法在 (C) 與 (D) 之間做出判斷。網頁則分別說明各項工作。Ridgeway 的搬運人員週六負責搬遷，並把每個箱子放到號碼相符的桌子旁。Ridgeway 的技術人員週日下午連接並測試電腦。新的牆面層架則由 Dockside 大樓業主另外安排，在搬遷日前裝好。兩篇對照後，裝車明確完成，電腦服務也沒有顯示異常（評論沒有逐一確認測試程序及完成時間）。只有箱子的擺放明確與說法不符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁說 Ridgeway 的搬運人員在 4 月 12 日週六負責搬遷。評論說週六的搬運小組中午前就全部裝車完畢，與說法一致。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評論說技術人員週日下午獲准進入，且週一每台電腦已連線並正常運作，沒有呈現這項服務未按說法完成的問題。相較之下，箱子擺放有明示的不符。評論並未逐一確認測試程序及完成時間，所以只能說這項服務沒有被指出問題，不能說已證明每個步驟都照說法完成。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。網頁說搬運人員會把每個箱子放到號碼相符的桌子旁，評論卻說箱子全堆在電梯旁，團隊還得自己花一個小時整理箱子。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評論確實說週一時層架還裝在箱子裡、放在走廊。但網頁說安排安裝層架的是大樓業主，這不是 Ridgeway 說自家人員會做的工作，所以不符合題目條件。

evidence.quote: our crew will place every crate at the desk with the matching number
The Dockside Building's owner, meanwhile, is having new wall shelves put up before moving day.
Our crates were all stacked by the elevator, and the wall shelves were still boxed in the corridor.
we lost an hour sorting crates ourselves
On Saturday, April 12, our crew will move it to the third floor of the Dockside Building.
the Saturday crew had everything loaded by noon
On Sunday afternoon, our technicians will connect and test the studio's computers.
even came back on Sunday afternoon to let the technicians in
On Monday morning, every computer was connected and running.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 做「承諾 vs. 實際經驗」題時，評論裡出現的問題不一定都屬於同一家公司的承諾。要回到原始說明，確認每項工作原本由誰負責。也要分清「評論沒有指出問題」和「已證明每個步驟都完成」：答案應選有明確不符證據的那一項。

questions.prompt: In the web page, the phrase "drawn up" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: 本句的 drawn up a floor plan 指「擬定一份平面配置圖」，換成 prepared 意思不變。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 原句說協調員 Della Moreno 參訪兩個地點後，和 Haddad 女士一起 drawn up a floor plan。這裡 draw up 的受詞是平面圖這類規劃文件，意思是「擬定、草擬」。下一句接著說明新空間的配置：大部分是一個開放式工作室，角落的房間則留作安靜工作之用，可見兩人規劃出了一份平面圖。把 prepared 代入原句，意思通順，所以選 (B)。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: draw up 表示「停下」時，常用於車輛（如 A taxi drew up outside.）。代入後變成「停下一份平面圖」，與「參訪兩地後和 Haddad 女士一起完成平面圖」的語境不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。代入後是「和 Haddad 女士一起擬定了一份平面圖」，與下一句說明的空間配置相呼應。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 描述實體物品時，draw up 可以表示把東西往上拉起。但這裡的平面圖並沒有被提起，句子說的是兩人規劃出一份平面圖。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: draw up a chair 是「把椅子拉近」，談的是實體物品的位置。這裡的平面圖是兩人新擬出來的文件，不是被拉近的物品。

evidence.quote: has visited both sites and drawn up a floor plan with Ms. Haddad
Most of the new space will be one open studio, but Ms. Haddad insisted that the corner room be set aside for quiet work

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義片語動詞要看受詞和上下文判斷意思。draw up 接計畫、文件時常表示「擬定」；描述車輛時可以表示「停下」；draw up a chair 則是把椅子拉近。把每個選項代回原句，檢查整句意思是否合理。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about Ms. Haddad's view of Ridgeway Office Moves?

options.label: A
options.text: She still trusts Ridgeway to put things in place despite the crate problem.

options.label: B
options.text: She now plans to have her own staff unpack anything Ridgeway delivers.

options.label: C
options.text: She had no complaints about how Ridgeway handled the April move.

options.label: D
options.text: She blames the crate problem on a poor plan for the new space.

explanation.summary_zh: 評論第二段說，箱子沒有放到位，害團隊損失一小時，她因此扣了一顆星。第一段卻說，她在這件事之後又預約 Ridgeway 六月拆箱上架。合起來可推論，她仍信任 Ridgeway 把東西放到位，所以 (A) 正確。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 評論沒有直接說她是否信任 Ridgeway，需要把兩段的資訊合起來看。第二段說，週一早上箱子全堆在電梯旁，團隊得自己花一小時整理，她並明說這就是扣一顆星的原因，顯示擺放物品的環節出了問題。第一段說，她上週已預約 Ridgeway 做第二份工作：六月把檔案箱從倉庫搬來，並拆箱放上層架。評論寫於 5 月 2 日，網頁顯示搬遷在 4 月 12 日週六，所以這次預約發生在箱子問題之後；六月的拆箱上架則是尚未進行的安排。她清楚對方曾沒把箱子放到位，仍把包含拆箱歸位的工作交給他們，可推論她仍信任 Ridgeway 把東西放好。只看第一段的預約和稱讚，(C)「沒有抱怨」似乎也說得通。只看第二段的箱子問題與自行整理，(B)「之後改由自家員工拆箱」似乎也說得通。兩段合起來，才能排除這兩個選項。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。她因箱子沒有放到位、損失一小時而扣星，可見她在意擺放物品的問題。但在這之後，她預約的六月工作正是請 Ridgeway 拆箱並放上層架。把需要歸位的工作再交給同一家公司，可推論她仍信任他們能把東西放到位。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這個選項有一定依據：箱子堆在電梯旁，她的團隊只好自己整理。但她已預約的六月工作明說由 Ridgeway unpack them onto our shelves（拆箱並放上層架），與「之後由自家員工拆箱」相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 第一段的再次預約，以及對規劃訪視、週六裝車和週一電腦的稱讚，單看似乎支持這個說法。但第二段說箱子堆在電梯旁、團隊損失一小時，她並明說因此扣了一顆星，可見她對四月搬遷有抱怨。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評論稱 Della Moreno 的規劃訪視 thorough（周到），也沒有把箱子問題歸因於空間規劃。這個選項沒有依據，也與她對規劃的稱讚不合。

evidence.quote: Our crates were all stacked by the elevator
we lost an hour sorting crates ourselves
That lost hour is why I've taken off one star.
Last week I booked Ridgeway for a second job: in June, they will bring our archive boxes from storage and unpack them onto our shelves.
Della Moreno's planning visit was thorough, and the Saturday crew had everything loaded by noon.
Reviewer: Noor Haddad, Lanternfish Studio | May 2
On Saturday, April 12, our crew will move it to the third floor of the Dockside Building.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論態度時，要把具體的評價（例如扣星的理由）和後續行動（例如再次委託）放在一起看。還要比對新委託的範圍，是否正好涉及先前出問題的環節。只看其中一部分時，常會有看似合理的干擾選項。

questions.prompt: Who is Sam Ortiz?

options.label: A
options.text: A technician who set up the computers on Sunday afternoon

options.label: B
options.text: The coordinator who visited both sites before the move

options.label: C
options.text: An animator who joined Lanternfish Studio in April

options.label: D
options.text: The leader of the Ridgeway crew that worked on Saturday

explanation.summary_zh: 評論說 Sam Ortiz "led that crew"，that crew 指前一句中午前完成裝車的週六搬運小組。所以他是 Ridgeway 週六搬運小組的領隊，(D) 正確。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 先找名字所在的句子：Sam Ortiz, who led that crew, even came back on Sunday afternoon to let the technicians in。關係子句 who led that crew 說明他的角色，that crew 回指前一句的 the Saturday crew。這篇是對 Ridgeway Office Moves 的評論，網頁也說週六由 Ridgeway 的 our crew 負責搬遷，所以他是 Ridgeway 週六搬運小組的領隊，(D) 有直接依據。他週日到場的明示任務是讓技術人員進門，文中並未說他本人設定電腦，所以 (A) 沒有依據。不過，僅憑開門這個動作，也不能斷定他的所有專業身分。網頁明確指出參訪兩地的協調員是 Della Moreno，文中也沒有任何地方說 Sam Ortiz 是 Lanternfish 的動畫師。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 他週日下午確實到場，但明示任務是讓技術人員進門 (let the technicians in)，文中並未說他本人設定電腦。網頁只說連接並測試電腦的是 Ridgeway 的技術人員，兩篇文件都沒有寫出技術人員的姓名。他的明示角色是週六搬運小組領隊，所以 D 有直接依據，A 則沒有。不過，僅憑開門動作不能斷定他的所有專業身分。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁明說參訪兩地、並和 Haddad 女士一起擬定平面圖的協調員是 Della Moreno，評論也把規劃訪視歸於她。B 描述的是 Della Moreno，不是 Sam Ortiz。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁只說有六位新動畫師在四月開始工作，沒有寫出姓名；評論中具名的動畫師是資深動畫師 Ama 和 Joel。文中沒有任何地方說 Sam Ortiz 是 Lanternfish 的動畫師，他出現時的明示角色是帶領週六搬運小組、週日回來讓技術人員進門。C 缺乏文本依據。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。who led that crew 中的 that crew 回指週六中午前完成裝車的搬運小組，網頁又說週六負責搬遷的是 Ridgeway 的 our crew，所以他是 Ridgeway 週六搬運小組的領隊。

evidence.quote: the Saturday crew had everything loaded by noon. Sam Ortiz, who led that crew, even came back on Sunday afternoon to let the technicians in.
On Saturday, April 12, our crew will move it to the third floor of the Dockside Building.
On Sunday afternoon, our technicians will connect and test the studio's computers.
Our move coordinator, Della Moreno, has visited both sites
With six new animators starting in April, the studio has run out of space.
Our senior animators, Ama and Joel, work in the open studio beside the six new animators

explanation.takeaway_zh: 人物身分題要先找到名字所在的句子，留意同位語或關係子句（如 who led that crew），並確認指稱回指的對象。作答時以文中明示的角色為準。單一動作（如替他人開門）不足以斷定或排除一個人的所有身分；選項描述的身分若沒有文本依據，就不能選。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the corner room in Lanternfish Studio's new space?

options.label: A
options.text: It has become a shared workspace for the senior animators.

options.label: B
options.text: It is being used in a way Ms. Haddad had wanted to avoid.

options.label: C
options.text: It is being used for the purpose Ms. Haddad had planned.

options.label: D
options.text: It is where the new animators bring their questions to senior staff.

explanation.summary_zh: 搬遷前的網頁引述 Haddad 女士的要求：角落的房間留作安靜工作之用，不接電話、不開會。搬遷後的評論卻說，這個房間是工作室和電視頻道每週通話的地方。實際用途正是她原本想排除的，所以 (B) 正確。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題要把搬遷前的偏好和搬遷後的實際用途連起來。網頁發布於搬遷前，說新空間大部分是開放式工作室，但 Haddad 女士堅持把角落的房間留作安靜工作之用，並明說不接電話、不開會。評論發布於搬遷後，說角落的房間是工作室和電視頻道每週通話的地方，而通話正屬於她當初想排除的電話、會議一類活動。只看評論，可以排除 (A) 和 (D)，但不知道她原本的規劃；評論談到新空間的用法時語氣又很正面，(C)「照原定用途使用」仍說得通。只看網頁，只知道規劃，不知道搬遷後的實際用途。兩篇對照後，才能確定房間的用途與她原本的要求相反。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評論說資深動畫師 Ama 和 Joel 在開放式工作室工作，坐在新動畫師旁邊；提到角落的房間時，說的是每週與電視頻道通話，沒有說它成了資深動畫師共用的工作空間。網頁也只說這個房間留作安靜工作之用，沒有指定給資深動畫師。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。網頁說她要求這個房間不接電話、不開會；評論說它被用來和電視頻道每週通話，兩篇合起來可知實際用途正是她原本想避免的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只看評論時，這個選項無法排除。但網頁說這個房間原本要留作安靜工作之用，而且不接電話、不開會；評論說它是每週通話的地方，與原本的規劃相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評論說新動畫師整天向 Ama 和 Joel 請教問題，描述的是他們在開放式工作室並肩工作的情形。評論提到角落的房間時，說的是每週與電視頻道的通話，不是新動畫師提問的地點。

Posted: March 24
Reviewer: Noor Haddad, Lanternfish Studio | May 2

explanation.takeaway_zh: 「偏好 vs. 結果」題通常分兩步：先在一篇文件找出當事人原本的要求，再到另一篇確認後來的實際用途。只看其中一篇時仍會有干擾選項說得通，要兩篇合起來才能確定答案。

content.title: Ferngate Bakehouse: A Tasting Story and What Followed
content.scenario_summary: A wholesale bakery's Partner News web page, written for its existing wholesale accounts, tells how a family grocery turned slow seeded-rye sales around. The grocer's nephew suggested slicing one loaf for Saturday samples, and the Saturday order grew from 10 to 36 loaves. The grocer's remaining problem is that the van arrives at about 8:40, after the store's 8:00 opening. The page offers partners a free tasting loaf in May and sends non-partners to another page. A café owner who is already a partner emails the wholesale contact to say he has requested his free tasting loaf through the portal. He then notes that rye comes only on the Saturday run while his café is closed on weekends, and asks how the loaf will reach him. The production manager's memo to the Friday overnight crew announces three changes. The Saturday van will leave at 5:45 instead of 6:30, the grocery will move from the last stop to the first, and orders must be packed by 5:30. From 5:15, a staff member without a stated title will check crates against the new route sheet at the loading door. A new Sunday-night rye bake will supply Monday deliveries and will include tasting loaves for partners closed on Saturdays, which go out with their Monday orders. Tasting loaves on Saturday orders will be marked with a T and handed over with the regular order. The grocer has asked that the same staff member put her store's rye onto its bread shelf when the van arrives. The questions test a paraphrased pre-change markdown fact and existing partners as the readership. They also test inferring that the staff member will travel with the Saturday delivery van: she is at the bakery's loading door before the van leaves and at the grocery, now the first stop, when it arrives. The loading-door check alone also fits someone who stays at the bakery, and the shelving request alone also fits a grocery employee; the memo does not say whether she drives. One cross-document question combines the email's weekend closure and portal request with the memo's arrangement for partners closed on Saturdays to determine what will happen to the café owner's loaf. Another links the earlier late-arrival problem to the route change.

blocks.text: Ferngate Bakehouse | Partner News
Posted: May 2
A Saturday Tasting at Dunmore Corner Grocery
Each month, we pass along an idea from one of the businesses we supply so that other partners can try it. This month's comes from Dunmore Corner Grocery, a family-run store on Dunmore Road.

When owner Delia Pell first stocked our seeded rye last autumn, most loaves sat on a back shelf beside the cereal, and by Monday she was marking leftovers down to half price. In February, her nephew Jonah, who opens the store on weekends, suggested slicing one loaf into samples at the front counter each Saturday morning.

The idea paid off quickly: Delia's Saturday order has grown from 10 loaves to 36, and the markdowns have stopped. Her only frustration is timing. Regulars now arrive at the 8:00 A.M. opening expecting rye, but our van does not reach her store until about 8:40.
Want to run your own tasting? Throughout May, partners can add one free tasting loaf to a single order through the partner portal.
Not yet a Ferngate partner? Visit our Wholesale Accounts page to apply.
From: Tomas Reyes <tomas@brightwatercafe.example>
To: Owen Marsh <owen.marsh@ferngate.example>
Date: May 6
Subject: Free tasting loaf for Brightwater
Hi Owen,

The Partner News story about Dunmore Corner Grocery gave me an idea, so this morning I requested our free tasting loaf through the partner portal. I'd like to offer rye samples at the counter on our busiest morning, when traders from the Quay Street market come in for breakfast.
After submitting the request, I realized that your seeded rye comes only on the Saturday run, and Brightwater is closed on weekends. I don't want the loaf left outside a locked door.
Could you let me know how it will reach us?

Tomas Reyes
Brightwater Café

documents.title: Memo to the Friday overnight baking crew

blocks.text: To: Friday overnight baking crew
From: Gita Okafor, Production Manager
Date: May 12
Subject: Changes starting the night of May 16

Starting Saturday, May 17, the delivery van will leave at 5:45 A.M. instead of 6:30, and Dunmore Corner Grocery will move from the last stop to the first. Please have all Saturday orders cooled and packed by 5:30. From 5:15, Lena Brandt will check each crate against the new route sheet at the loading door.

Seeded rye will also be baked on Sunday nights, beginning May 18, for Monday delivery. That shift will include the free tasting loaves requested by partners who are closed on Saturdays; those loaves will go out with their Monday orders. Owen Marsh will tell all partners that Monday rye is now available. The two bakers who joined us in April will cover the shift.

Finally, free tasting loaves on Saturday orders will be marked with a T on packing lists. Please wrap them separately so they can be handed over with the regular order. Delia Pell has asked that Lena put Dunmore Corner Grocery's rye straight onto the store's bread shelf when the van arrives, so please pack that rye in its own crate and load it last.

questions.prompt: Before the Saturday tastings began, what did Ms. Pell do with unsold loaves of seeded rye?

options.label: A
options.text: She returned them to Ferngate for a credit.

options.label: B
options.text: She lowered their price by the start of the week.

options.label: C
options.text: She sliced them into samples for shoppers.

options.label: D
options.text: She moved them to a shelf near the front counter.

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁說，試吃開始前賣不完的麵包「by Monday she was marking leftovers down to half price」，也就是到了週一，她就把剩下的麵包降成半價。B「在一週開始時降價」是正確的改寫。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題幹有兩個定位條件：「試吃開始之前」和「賣剩的麵包」。d1-b5 第一句描述去年秋天剛進貨時的情況：麵包大多放在穀片旁的後方架上，到週一她就把剩貨降為半價。mark down 指降價，half price 改寫為 lowered their price，by Monday 則改寫為 by the start of the week。第二句的切片試吃，是二月起姪子 Jonah 提出的新做法，不是先前處理剩貨的方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中沒有提到把麵包退回 Ferngate，也沒有提到換取抵扣額（credit），屬於文件未提及的內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。marking leftovers down to half price 指把剩下的麵包降價出售，by Monday 對應 by the start of the week。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中確實提到切片試吃，但那是二月起 Jonah 建議的做法，而且是每週六早上切「一條」麵包供試吃。它不是試吃開始前處理賣剩麵包的方式，時間與用途都被錯置。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: front counter 是後來提供試吃的地點。試吃開始前，麵包放在 back shelf beside the cereal（穀片旁的後方架上）。文中沒有說她把剩貨移到櫃檯附近。

evidence.quote: most loaves sat on a back shelf beside the cereal, and by Monday she was marking leftovers down to half price
suggested slicing one loaf into samples at the front counter each Saturday morning

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題先用題幹的時間條件（如 before...）定位到正確的時段，再把關鍵動詞片語換句話說來比對（mark down → lower the price）。同一段落中屬於「之後」的新做法，常被拿來當干擾選項。

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁說每月分享一個點子「so that other partners can try it」，又說 partners 可以透過 partner portal，在一筆訂單中加一條免費試吃麵包。可見讀者是已經向 Ferngate 進貨的合作商家，答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 判斷讀者時，要看文件「對誰說話」以及「要讀者做什麼」。第一，d1-b4 說點子是分享給 other partners 試用，other 表示讀者本身也是 Ferngate 供貨的夥伴。第二，d1-b7 問 Want to run your own tasting?，接著說 partners 可以透過 partner portal 在 a single order 中加一條試吃麵包，表示讀者本來就透過 portal 向 Ferngate 下訂單。第三，d1-b8 對「Not yet a Ferngate partner?」的商家，只是請他們到另一個頁面申請，可見潛在客戶不是本頁的主要讀者。

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 頁尾確實提到尚未成為夥伴的商家，但只是請他們 Visit our Wholesale Accounts page to apply，把他們導向別的頁面。本頁的主要內容（分享點子、透過 portal 在訂單中加麵包）是寫給已有合作關係的商家。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。other partners、your own tasting，以及 add one free tasting loaf to a single order through the partner portal，都指向已經向 Ferngate 進貨的商家。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁以 our van、businesses we supply 的口吻，由 Ferngate 對外部商家說話。給烘焙人員的包裝與出貨指示出現在備忘錄（d3），不在這個網頁。

evidence.quote: Each month, we pass along an idea from one of the businesses we supply so that other partners can try it.
Throughout May, partners can add one free tasting loaf to a single order through the partner portal.
Not yet a Ferngate partner? Visit our Wholesale Accounts page to apply.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷目標讀者時，先找出 you/your 指向誰、讀者被要求採取什麼行動，並留意文件是否把某些群體轉介到別處。被提及或被轉介的群體，不一定是主要讀者。

options.label: B

explanation.summary_zh: 備忘錄沒有直接說 Lena 會隨車。但她從 5:15 起在裝貨門核對貨箱，貨車 5:45 才出發；她又被要求在貨車抵達時，把 Dunmore Corner Grocery 的黑麥麵包直接放上店內麵包架，而這家店現在是第一站。出車前她在麵包坊，到站時她在雜貨店，最合理的推論是她跟著週六的送貨車一起去，答案是 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 這題要結合兩個互補的線索，再對照第一段的時間表。線索一（d3-b5）：5:15 起，Lena 在裝貨門依新路線表核對每個貨箱，而貨車 5:45 出發。單看這點，她可能出車後就留在麵包坊（B）。線索二（d3-b7）：Delia Pell 要求 Lena 在貨車抵達時，把雜貨店的黑麥麵包直接放上麵包架；備忘錄也據此要求員工把這批麵包單獨裝箱、最後裝車。單看這點，她也可能是雜貨店的員工（D）。兩點合起來看：她在出車前位於麵包坊裝貨門，貨車一抵達第一站，她又要在雜貨店上架，因此最可能隨車同行。不過，備忘錄沒有說她是否負責開車，A 也只說「隨車」，不是「開車」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。出車前她在裝貨門核對貨箱，貨車抵達第一站 Dunmore Corner Grocery 時，她又要把麵包上架，兩者結合可推知她隨週六的送貨車同行。這是推論，備忘錄沒有明寫，也沒有說她開車。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 單看 5:15 起在裝貨門核對貨箱，B 說得通。但 Delia 要求她在貨車抵達時把麵包放上店內麵包架，表示貨車到雜貨店時她人在那裡，與出車後留在麵包坊不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Lena 的工作是核對貨箱、到店上架，都屬於實際送貨的處理，文中沒有把她和合作商家的帳戶連在一起。備忘錄中負責通知所有合作商家的是 Owen Marsh。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 單看到店上架的要求，D 似乎可能。但這份給 Ferngate 夜班的備忘錄安排她 5:15 起在裝貨門，依新的送貨路線表核對每個貨箱，可見她在出車前就在麵包坊工作，不像雜貨店的員工。

evidence.quote: Starting Saturday, May 17, the delivery van will leave at 5:45 A.M. instead of 6:30, and Dunmore Corner Grocery will move from the last stop to the first.
From 5:15, Lena Brandt will check each crate against the new route sheet at the loading door.
Delia Pell has asked that Lena put Dunmore Corner Grocery's rye straight onto the store's bread shelf when the van arrives, so please pack that rye in its own crate and load it last.
Owen Marsh will tell all partners that Monday rye is now available.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論角色或行蹤時，把同一個人在不同時間、地點的行動，和文件中的時間表（出車時間、停靠順序）放在一起看。單一線索常同時符合兩種解讀，合起來才能排除。也要分清「隨車」與「開車」：文件沒說的細節，不要自行補上。

explanation.summary_zh: Tomas 已透過 partner portal 申請免費試吃麵包，而他的 Brightwater 週末不營業。備忘錄說，週六不營業的合作商家所申請的試吃麵包，會在週日晚上烤好，隨他們的週一訂單送出。所以他的麵包最可能隨週一訂單送達，答案是 D。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 電子郵件（d2）提供 Tomas 的情況：他透過 partner portal 申請了免費試吃麵包，可見他是合作商家；Ferngate 的黑麥麵包只在週六送，但 Brightwater 週末（包括週六）不營業，他因此詢問麵包要怎麼送到。單看 d2，看不出 Ferngate 會怎麼處理，甚至會以為只能隨週六的車送。備忘錄（d3）規定，週六不營業的合作商家所申請的試吃麵包，由週日晚班烤製，隨週一訂單送出。但 d3 沒有提到 Brightwater 或 Tomas，單看 d3 無法知道他適用哪一種處理方式。把 d2 的「已申請、週末不營業」和 d3 的規則連起來，就能判斷他的麵包會隨週一訂單送達。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 三份文件都沒有提到由店家派人到麵包坊自取。Tomas 只問麵包要怎麼送到，備忘錄也沒有任何自取安排。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 備忘錄第三段說，週六訂單中的試吃麵包會標上 T，隨一般訂單交付，但這適用於週六有訂單的店家。Tomas 的店週末不營業，他也擔心麵包被放在鎖著的門外。他屬於第二段所說的「週六不營業的合作商家」，適用週一的處理方式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文件中沒有任何週五的配送。Friday 只出現在備忘錄的收件對象（Friday overnight baking crew），備忘錄要這組人員在週六清晨 5:30 前包好週六的訂單。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Brightwater 週末不營業，符合 partners who are closed on Saturdays；這類商家申請的試吃麵包 will go out with their Monday orders。

evidence.quote: this morning I requested our free tasting loaf through the partner portal
After submitting the request, I realized that your seeded rye comes only on the Saturday run, and Brightwater is closed on weekends. I don't want the loaf left outside a locked door.
That shift will include the free tasting loaves requested by partners who are closed on Saturdays; those loaves will go out with their Monday orders.
Finally, free tasting loaves on Saturday orders will be marked with a T on packing lists. Please wrap them separately so they can be handed over with the regular order.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 這類跨文件題，先在一份文件確認當事人的條件（已申請、週末不營業），再到另一份文件找適用該條件的規則。相關文件中常同時出現兩種處理方式（週六與週一），要依條件判斷當事人屬於哪一種。

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁提到 Dunmore Corner Grocery 早上 8:00 開門，但送貨車約 8:40 才到。備忘錄第一段把週六出車時間從 6:30 提前到 5:45，並把這家店從最後一站改為第一站。最合理的原因是這家店在開門後才收到麵包，答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: d3-b5 只說明變更內容（5:45 出車、Dunmore Corner Grocery 由最後一站改為第一站，訂單須在 5:30 前包好），沒有說明原因。d1-b6 描述這家店的困擾：熟客 8:00 一開門就來買黑麥麵包，但貨車約 8:40 才到。提前出車並把這家店排成第一站，正好回應「開門後才收到麵包」的問題。只看 d3，無法在「到貨晚於開門」和其他可能原因之間做判斷；只看 d1，則不知道備忘錄第一段做了什麼變更。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 週末不營業的是 Brightwater Café（d2），它的情況對應備忘錄第二段：週日晚上烤黑麥麵包供週一配送，週六不營業商家的試吃麵包隨週一訂單送出。第一段調整的是週六出車時間和停靠順序，對週末休息的咖啡館沒有幫助。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。店家 8:00 開門，貨車約 8:40 才到，也就是麵包在開門後才送達。備忘錄讓貨車提早出發，並把這家店排成第一站，正好回應這個問題。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 五月免費試吃麵包活動（d1-b7）對應備忘錄第二段的週一處理方式和第三段的 T 標記，與出車時間和停靠順序無關。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 三份文件都沒有提到交通狀況。網頁只說貨車約 8:40 才到，並未說明是塞車造成。

evidence.quote: Regulars now arrive at the 8:00 A.M. opening expecting rye, but our van does not reach her store until about 8:40.
the delivery van will leave at 5:45 A.M. instead of 6:30, and Dunmore Corner Grocery will move from the last stop to the first

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論「為何做出某回應」的跨文件題，先在較晚的文件確認回應的具體內容，再回到較早的文件找對應的問題。干擾選項常是其他變更的起因，要確認每個原因和哪一項回應配對。

content.title: Engineering Work and a Revised Trip to the Kessington Home Show
content.scenario_summary: Rail travel triple set. A rail operator's notice announces Saturday engineering work between Dunmore and Ardley Junction until 16:00. Passengers may take replacement buses, which cannot carry items longer than one metre, or trains via Pelling, where connections are held for up to ten minutes. Advance tickets for a specific train must be exchanged free of charge at a staffed ticket office before they can be used via Pelling. Seat reservations do not apply, and refunds are only for passengers who decide not to travel. A special morning timetable lists bus-route and Pelling departures with arrival times. In the e-mail, a team leader tells her trade show team about revised travel. Their booked 06:50 now starts with a bus. A colleague, Joon, spotted the notice, measured the 1.4-metre display cases and had the stand setup slot moved, so the team can take the 07:20 via Pelling. The leader will sort out the tickets. Another colleague, Farah, has a call until 10:00, may use the buses, and must choose her own departure that reaches the hall before the doors open at 13:00. The questions test five points. The first is the e-mail's main purpose (travel change versus subordinate thanks). The second is the leader's ticket follow-up, inferred from the chosen non-bus train and the notice's exchange rule. The third is the contextual sense of 'held' (delayed). The fourth is Farah's departure, matched from her constraints to the timetable (10:20). The fifth is an action NOT mentioned as Joon's (booking Farah's ticket).

documents.title: Valecrest Rail Customer Notice: Engineering Work on June 14

blocks.text: Valecrest Rail Customer Notice
Engineering Work: Dunmore – Ardley Junction
Date: Saturday, June 14, from the start of service until 16:00
Track renewal will close the line between Dunmore and Ardley Junction during these hours. Passengers travelling from Dunmore to Kessington can choose either option below.
Replacement buses: Buses will run from Dunmore Station to Ardley Junction, where passengers will join trains to Kessington. Items longer than one metre cannot be carried on the buses.

Trains via Pelling: Passengers who would rather avoid the buses can travel by train via Pelling and change there for Kessington. At Pelling, connecting trains will be held for up to ten minutes if the train from Dunmore is running late.

Tickets: All tickets dated June 14, including advance tickets, are accepted on the replacement buses. Advance tickets for a specific train may be used via Pelling only after being exchanged, free of charge, at a staffed ticket office before travel. Seat reservations will not apply on June 14. Passengers who decide not to travel may claim a full refund.
Valecrest Rail Special Timetable
Saturday, June 14: Dunmore to Kessington, morning departures
Arrival times include the change at Ardley Junction or Pelling.
Normal service resumes at 16:00.
From: Celia Marsh
To: Home Show team
Date: June 9
Subject: Change to our June 14 travel
Hi all,

Our June 14 trip to the Kessington Home Show falls on the day Valecrest Rail is closing the line between Dunmore and Ardley Junction. The 06:50 departure we have advance tickets for will now start with a replacement bus, so our plans have changed.

Thanks go to Joon for catching this in time. He spotted the notice at Dunmore Station last week and measured our two display cases: at 1.4 metres, they are too long for the buses. He then called the exhibition hall and had our setup slot moved from 09:30 to 10:30. That means we can take the 07:20 instead and still have the stand ready well before the doors open to the public at 13:00. Thank you, Joon!
Please meet at the main entrance of Dunmore Station by 07:00. Leave the tickets to me; I will sort them out before the trip. Our 18:40 return train is not affected.

Farah, you have a client call at the office until 10:00, so you will travel separately. Since you are bringing only your laptop, the buses are fine for you. Please choose a departure from the attached timetable that gets you to the hall before the doors open, and book your own ticket. The office is a few minutes' walk from Dunmore Station, and the hall is directly opposite Kessington Station.
Celia

explanation.summary_zh: 主旨行、開頭與後段的指示，都在說明 6 月 14 日的行程因施工而改變，以及新的集合、車票與車次安排。因此信件的主要目的是說明行程變更。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 判斷主旨要看全文架構。主旨行「Change to our June 14 travel」和第一段先說明：原訂的 06:50 班次將改由替代巴士開始，所以計畫有變。第二段說明新方案是怎麼來的：Joon 發現公告、量了展示箱、調整了布置時段，因此可以改搭 07:20。後面依序交代集合時間和地點、車票由 Celia 處理、回程不受影響，以及 Farah 如何自選車次。感謝 Joon 是信中真實的內容，但它是用來說明新行程的由來，屬於次要內容。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中確實感謝 Joon（Thanks go to Joon… Thank you, Joon!），但這段是在交代新計畫如何促成。主旨行，以及集合、車票、Farah 車次等其餘段落，都圍繞行程變更，因此感謝是次要目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只有 Farah 被要求「book your own ticket」。其他團隊成員的車票由 Celia 處理（Leave the tickets to me），所以信件並不是要大家自行買票。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信件從主旨行到結尾，都在說明原訂班次受施工影響、改搭 07:20，以及隨之而來的集合、車票和個別成員的交通安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中改變的是展位布置時段（從 09:30 改到 10:30）。13:00 對外開門只是被提及的時間，信中沒有說它改變。此選項把布置時段的調整誤當成展覽開放時間的變更。

The 06:50 departure we have advance tickets for will now start with a replacement bus, so our plans have changed.
Thanks go to Joon for catching this in time.
Please meet at the main entrance of Dunmore Station by 07:00. Leave the tickets to me; I will sort them out before the trip.
and book your own ticket

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題要看主旨行、開頭與多數段落共同服務的功能。信中確實出現、但只占一部分的內容（例如致謝），常被設計成「次要目的」的干擾選項。

options.text: Exchange the team's advance tickets on the rail company's website

options.label: C
options.text: Keep the team's advance tickets unchanged for use on the replacement buses

options.label: D
options.text: Pay a fee to exchange the team's advance tickets for new ones

explanation.summary_zh: 信件指出，團隊持有 06:50 班次的預售票，但展示箱太長不能上巴士，所以改搭 07:20，並由 Celia Marsh 在出發前處理車票。公告規定，指定班次的預售票須在出發前到有人員服務的售票處免費換票，才能經 Pelling 使用。綜合兩份文件，她最可能到售票處換票。
explanation.reasoning_zh:
本題要同時確定兩件事：這些預售票要不要換，以及換的話怎麼換。

只看公告（加上題幹與選項）：公告寫明換票要「at a staffed ticket office」，而且「free of charge」，因此可以排除 B（網站換票）和 D（付費換票）。但公告也寫明「All tickets dated June 14, including advance tickets, are accepted on the replacement buses」。如果團隊搭巴士，車票不需更動就能使用，所以 C 仍然成立。公告沒有說明這個團隊選哪條路線，因此只看公告時 A 與 C 都說得通。

只看信件：信中說展示箱長 1.4 公尺，「too long for the buses」，所以團隊「take the 07:20 instead」。這排除了把車票原封不動留著搭巴士的 C。不過信件只說「I will sort them out before the trip」，沒有說在哪裡辦理，也沒有說是否收費，所以 A、B、D 都無法排除。

兩份文件合起來：公告只提供替代巴士和經 Pelling 的火車兩種走法，團隊避開巴士，就是經 Pelling 搭車。時刻表也列出 07:20 為「Train via Pelling」，可作為佐證。依公告，指定班次的預售票必須先在有人員服務的售票處免費換票，才能經 Pelling 使用，因此答案是 A。信件加公告已足以選出答案，時刻表只是確認 07:20 路線的輔助來源。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。團隊手上是 06:50 指定班次的預售票，卻改搭經 Pelling 的 07:20。依公告，這種票要在出發前到有人員服務的售票處免費換票，才能經 Pelling 使用。這正符合 Celia「出發前處理車票」的說法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只看信件時，網站換票和 A 同樣可能，因為信中沒有說在哪裡辦理。但公告寫明，讓預售票能經 Pelling 使用的換票地點是「a staffed ticket office」，所以此選項不符合公告的規定。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只看公告時，這個選項說得通：公告寫明 6 月 14 日的預售票可直接搭替代巴士。但信件指出展示箱長 1.4 公尺，太長不能上巴士（公告也規定超過一公尺的物品不能帶上巴士），團隊因此改搭 07:20。車票不更動、留著搭巴士，就不符合團隊的實際行程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只看信件無法排除，因為信中沒有提到換票是否收費。但公告寫明換票「free of charge」，所以不需要付費。

evidence.quote: From: Celia Marsh
The 06:50 departure we have advance tickets for will now start with a replacement bus
at 1.4 metres, they are too long for the buses
That means we can take the 07:20 instead
Leave the tickets to me; I will sort them out before the trip.
Items longer than one metre cannot be carried on the buses.
Passengers who would rather avoid the buses can travel by train via Pelling and change there for Kessington.
All tickets dated June 14, including advance tickets, are accepted on the replacement buses.
Advance tickets for a specific train may be used via Pelling only after being exchanged, free of charge, at a staffed ticket office before travel.
Train via Pelling

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件推論「下一步」時，先用一份文件確定當事人的實際選擇（避開巴士、改搭經 Pelling 的車），再用另一份文件中適用於該選擇的規則，判斷辦理方式（地點、費用）。只適用於另一種選擇的規則（例如「車票可直接搭巴士」）就不能套用。

questions.prompt: In the notice, the word "held" in the paragraph about trains via Pelling is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: 「connecting trains will be held for up to ten minutes if the train from Dunmore is running late」是指 Dunmore 來車誤點時，轉乘列車最多晚開十分鐘等候旅客，所以 held 在此的意思是 delayed（延後發車）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: hold 是多義動詞，要看主詞與上下文的條件來判斷。這裡的主詞是「connecting trains」（轉乘列車），後面接時間長度「for up to ten minutes」，再加上條件「if the train from Dunmore is running late」（Dunmore 來車誤點時）。三者合起來，表示讓轉乘列車暫緩開出，等誤點的列車到站。因此對應「delayed」。代回原句成為「connecting trains will be delayed for up to ten minutes」，意思和被動語態中過去分詞的角色都保持一致。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: hold 確實有「保留、預留」的意思（如 hold a seat），但這裡被 hold 的是列車本身。配合「最多十分鐘」與誤點條件，句意是列車暫緩發車等人。代入 reserved 無法表達「晚開」這個重點。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。轉乘列車在來車誤點時最多延後十分鐘發車。delayed 完整保留原意，也符合被動語態中過去分詞的語法角色。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: organized 對應 hold a meeting（舉辦會議）的意思。「列車被舉辦十分鐘」在此說不通，也與誤點條件無關。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: supported 對應 hold 的「支撐、承重」意思，與列車因來車誤點而等候的情境無關。

evidence.quote: At Pelling, connecting trains will be held for up to ten minutes if the train from Dunmore is running late.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 同義字題先找出該字的主詞或受詞，以及句中的時間、條件線索，再把每個選項代回原句檢查。不要只憑這個字在其他語境中常見的意思作答。

questions.prompt: Which departure from Dunmore should Farah most likely choose?

explanation.summary_zh: Farah 開會到 10:00，可以搭巴士，並須在 13:00 開門前到會場（會場就在 Kessington 車站正對面）。時刻表中只有 10:20 這班在會議結束後發車，又在 13:00 前（12:50）抵達。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 先從信件整理 Farah 的條件。第一，客戶電話會議在辦公室進行到 10:00，辦公室到 Dunmore 車站只要步行幾分鐘。第二，她只帶筆電，信中說「the buses are fine」，所以巴士轉乘路線也可以搭。第三，信中要她選一班「在開門前到會場」的車次；開門時間是 13:00，會場就在 Kessington 車站正對面。再對照時刻表：10:00 以後的早上班次只有兩班，10:20（巴士轉乘，12:50 到）和 10:35（經 Pelling，13:10 到），只有 10:20 能在開門前抵達。信件說明了 Farah 的條件，但沒有列出可選班次與抵達時間；時刻表列出班次，卻沒有 Farah 的條件。因此兩份文件都必須用到。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 08:50 雖然 11:20 就到 Kessington，但發車時 Farah 的電話會議還沒結束（要到 10:00），她無法搭乘。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 09:20 經 Pelling，11:55 抵達，趕得上開門，但同樣在 10:00 會議結束前發車，Farah 無法搭乘。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。10:20 在會議結束後發車，辦公室離車站只要步行幾分鐘。這班是巴士轉乘，信中說巴士對 Farah 沒問題。12:50 抵達後，會場就在車站正對面，可在 13:00 開門前到達。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 10:35 雖在會議結束後發車，但 13:10 才抵達 Kessington，晚於 13:00 開門，不符合信中「在開門前到會場」的要求。

evidence.quote: Farah, you have a client call at the office until 10:00
Since you are bringing only your laptop, the buses are fine for you.
Please choose a departure from the attached timetable that gets you to the hall before the doors open
the hall is directly opposite Kessington Station
the doors open to the public at 13:00
Arrival times include the change at Ardley Junction or Pelling.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依需求選擇方案時，先整理「最早可出發時間」、「最晚抵達時間」和「交通方式限制」三項條件，再對照時刻表的同一列，把發車與抵達時間一起看。也要注意，不要把別人的限制（團隊因展示箱而避開巴士）套用到另一個人身上。

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail as something Joon did?

options.label: A
options.text: He booked a train ticket for Farah.

options.label: B
options.text: He saw the rail company's notice at a station.

options.label: C
options.text: He checked the size of the team's display cases.

options.label: D
options.text: He arranged a later setup time at the hall.

explanation.summary_zh: 信中沒有提到 Joon 替 Farah 訂票，反而要求 Farah 自己訂票，所以 A 是未被提及的選項。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 信件第二段列出 Joon 做的事：在 Dunmore 車站看到公告、量了兩個展示箱、打電話給展覽館，把布置時段從 09:30 改到 10:30。B、C、D 都能在這一段找到換句話說的對應。信中沒有任何地方提到 Joon 替 Farah 訂票；最後一段反而要求 Farah 自己訂票。題目問的是信中「沒有提到」的 Joon 的行為，因此答案是 A。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確答案。信中要求 Farah 自己選車次並「book your own ticket」，全文沒有提到 Joon 替她訂票。此選項把信中出現的「訂票」這件事，連到了文中並未提及的執行者 Joon 身上。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。「He spotted the notice at Dunmore Station last week」，即他在車站看到了鐵路公司的公告。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。「measured our two display cases」，他量了展示箱的尺寸，得知長 1.4 公尺，太長不能上巴士。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。「called the exhibition hall and had our setup slot moved from 09:30 to 10:30」，即他安排了較晚的布置時段。

evidence.quote: He spotted the notice at Dunmore Station last week and measured our two display cases
He then called the exhibition hall and had our setup slot moved from 09:30 to 10:30.
Please choose a departure from the attached timetable that gets you to the hall before the doors open, and book your own ticket.

explanation.takeaway_zh: NOT 題要逐一回到原文核對每個選項，特別留意人物是否對錯：某個動作在文中確實出現，但文中並沒有把它歸給題目問的那個人。

content.title: Westgate Pool Open Studio Days
content.scenario_summary: An architectural studio posts a notice on April 1 inviting residents to open studio days (April 9 to 11) for its design of a replacement Westgate Pool. The notice promises that the project architect and her team will be at a scale model throughout opening hours and says that no activity requires booking. It lists two ways to comment: cards beside the model during the open days, or the studio's website until April 24. Printed plans can be viewed at the library until the same date. A programme revised on April 6, presented as a dated list, requires visitors to reserve virtual reality walk-through sessions. It also adds a design-team site walk at the current pool on the afternoon of April 11, when the model display becomes self-guided. A swim club chair relied on the notice and visited during that site walk. She found no architects, and the busy receptionist could not say when anyone would return. She emails the project architect to arrange a committee meeting before comments close. The questions test five points. The first asks where a comment could be submitted on a date after the open days, with the library's matching deadline as a lure. The second tests the booking change for the walk-through between the notice and the programme. The third matches the visit time in the email to the programme to identify what the team was scheduled to be doing. The fourth tests 'go over' meaning review. The fifth asks for the email's purpose, a meeting request, as distinct from its trigger and from misassigned details.

documents.title: Open Studio Days: The New Westgate Pool

blocks.text: Open Studio Days: The New Westgate Pool
Larchfield Architects, 14 Quay Street | Posted April 1

Larchfield Architects is designing the replacement for Westgate Pool, and we want to hear from the people who will use it. From April 9 to 11, our studio will be open to the public from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M.

A 1:50 scale model of the new pool will be on display in our ground-floor gallery. Project architect Selin Brandt and her design team will be at the model throughout opening hours to answer your questions. In the second-floor meeting room, you can take a virtual reality walk-through of the new building. The walk-through lasts about 20 minutes, and no booking is needed for this or any other activity.

Comment cards will be available beside the model during the open days, and responses can also be submitted at larchfield.example/westgate until April 24. Printed copies of the plans can be viewed at Westgate Library until the same date. Once comments close, our team will go over every response, and in mid-May we will share what we heard at a public meeting at Westgate Community Centre.

documents.title: Westgate Pool Open Studio Days: Programme

blocks.text: Westgate Pool Open Studio Days: Programme
Larchfield Architects | Revised April 6
April 9 to 11, 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M.: Virtual reality walk-through, second-floor meeting room. Sessions last 20 minutes; please reserve a time at reception.
April 9 and 10, 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M.: Model display with design team Q&A, ground-floor gallery
April 11, 10:00 A.M. to 12:30 P.M.: Model display with design team Q&A, ground-floor gallery
April 11, 1:00 to 3:30 P.M.: Site walk around the current pool with the design team (meet at the Westgate Pool main gate)
April 11, 1:00 to 4:00 P.M.: Model display (self-guided), ground-floor gallery
From: Hannah Okafor <h.okafor@westgatemasters.example>
To: Selin Brandt <s.brandt@larchfield.example>
Date: April 13
Subject: Westgate Pool open studio
Dear Ms. Brandt,

I chair the Westgate Masters Swim Club, whose members train at the current pool four mornings a week. Your studio's notice in the pool's lobby said you and your team would be at the model throughout the open days, so three club members and I visited the studio on April 11, arriving at about 1:15 P.M.

The model was impressive, but no one from the design team was in the gallery, and the busy receptionist could not say when anyone would be back. We filled in comment cards and waited until about 2:30 before we had to leave.

Our questions are specific: whether the new main pool will keep eight lanes, and whether the changing rooms can cope with thirty swimmers arriving at once before early training. These are hard to cover on a card. Would you or a colleague be willing to meet our committee before comments close? We could visit the studio again, or we would be glad to host you at the pool on any weekday evening after 7:00.

Kind regards,
Hannah Okafor
Chair, Westgate Masters Swim Club

questions.prompt: According to the notice, where could a resident submit a comment on April 20?

options.label: C
options.text: Beside the model in the studio gallery

explanation.summary_zh: 公告說，模型旁的意見卡只在開放日（during the open days）提供，而網站 larchfield.example/westgate 收件至 4 月 24 日。4 月 20 日開放日已經結束，但還在網站截止日之前，所以當天能提交意見的地方是網站，答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目有兩個條件：「提交意見」和「4 月 20 日」。公告提到兩種提交方式：模型旁的意見卡（during the open days）和網站（until April 24）。第一段說明工作室在 4 月 9 日至 11 日對外開放，這三天就是 open days，所以 4 月 20 日已不在意見卡的提供期間。網站的截止日是 4 月 24 日，20 日仍可提交。Westgate Library 的期限雖然也是 4 月 24 日，但公告只說那裡可以「查看」紙本平面圖。Westgate Community Centre 則是五月中舉行公開會議的地點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 圖書館的期限同樣是 4 月 24 日，容易讓人以為 4 月 20 日也能在那裡交意見。但公告只寫 Printed copies of the plans can be viewed，也就是可以查看紙本平面圖，沒有提到圖書館收意見。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。公告寫 responses can also be submitted at larchfield.example/westgate until April 24。4 月 20 日在截止日之前，可以透過 Larchfield 的網站提交意見。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 模型旁確實有意見卡，但只在 during the open days 提供。開放日是 4 月 9 日至 11 日，到 4 月 20 日已經結束，不符合題目的日期條件。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 社區中心是意見截止後、五月中舉行公開會議分享意見內容的地點。公告沒有說 4 月 20 日可以在那裡交意見。

evidence.quote: Comment cards will be available beside the model during the open days, and responses can also be submitted at larchfield.example/westgate until April 24.
From April 9 to 11, our studio will be open to the public from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M.
Printed copies of the plans can be viewed at Westgate Library until the same date.
in mid-May we will share what we heard at a public meeting at Westgate Community Centre

explanation.takeaway_zh: 題目指定某個日期時，要同時核對每個地點的「用途」和「適用期間」。兩個地點的期限相同，不代表它們提供相同的服務。

questions.prompt: Between the posting of the notice and the issue of the schedule, what changed about the virtual reality walk-through?

options.label: A
options.text: Visitors were asked to reserve a session time.

options.label: B
options.text: It was moved to the ground-floor gallery.

options.label: C
options.text: Its sessions were shortened to 20 minutes.

options.label: D
options.text: It was dropped from the final open day.

explanation.summary_zh: 4 月 1 日的公告說，虛擬實境導覽和其他活動都不需預約；4 月 6 日更新的節目表則要求到接待櫃台預約時段。前後唯一不同的是預約規定，答案是 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 這題要把同一項活動在兩份文件中的條件逐項對照。地點：公告寫 In the second-floor meeting room，節目表也寫 second-floor meeting room。長度：公告說 about 20 minutes，節目表寫 Sessions last 20 minutes。日期：節目表寫 April 9 to 11，仍包含最後一天。唯一不一致的是預約：公告寫 no booking is needed，節目表卻寫 please reserve a time at reception。只看節目表，無法知道預約是新規定，也無法判斷 20 分鐘是否為縮短後的長度；只看公告，則看不到之後的要求。所以必須結合兩份文件。郵件完全沒有提到虛擬實境導覽。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。公告明說 no booking is needed for this or any other activity，節目表卻要求 please reserve a time at reception，可見規定從「不需預約」改為「需要預約時段」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩份文件都把虛擬實境導覽安排在二樓會議室（second-floor meeting room）。一樓藝廊（ground-floor gallery）是展示模型的地點，這個選項把模型的地點錯配給導覽。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 公告已說導覽 lasts about 20 minutes，與節目表的 Sessions last 20 minutes 一致，長度並沒有縮短。只看節目表的人容易誤選這一項。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 節目表列出的虛擬實境導覽日期是 April 9 to 11，最後一天 4 月 11 日仍有提供，沒有取消。

evidence.quote: Posted April 1
The walk-through lasts about 20 minutes, and no booking is needed for this or any other activity.
In the second-floor meeting room, you can take a virtual reality walk-through of the new building.

April 9 to 11, 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M.: Virtual reality walk-through, second-floor meeting room.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 問「前後有什麼改變」的題目，要把同一項目在較早與較晚文件中的地點、日期、長度、規定逐項比對。兩邊一致的屬性就不是改變。

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Leading a walk around the current pool site

options.label: D

explanation.summary_zh: 郵件說 Okafor 女士 4 月 11 日約下午 1:15 抵達，待到約 2:30 才離開。節目表顯示，當天下午 1:00 至 3:30 由設計團隊帶領現有泳池周邊的步行導覽。她到訪的時段正好落在這段行程內，答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件提供到訪的日期和時段，但沒有說團隊去了哪裡；節目表列出 4 月 11 日的各項安排，但沒有她的到訪時間，因此要把兩者對照。公告雖說團隊整個開放時段都會在模型旁，但 4 月 6 日更新的節目表把 4 月 11 日有設計團隊問答的模型展示限於上午 10:00 至 12:30。下午 1:00 至 4:00 的模型展示則是 self-guided（自行參觀）。同一時段標明有設計團隊參與的，只有 1:00 至 3:30 的 Site walk。所以她在工作室時，團隊依安排正在現有泳池帶步行導覽。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這是公告的原始說法（團隊整個開放時段都在模型旁）。但節目表顯示，4 月 11 日有團隊問答的模型展示只在上午 10:00 至 12:30，下午改為自行參觀。郵件也說藝廊裡沒有設計團隊的人。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 節目表的虛擬實境導覽項目只寫了時間、地點和預約方式，沒有說由設計團隊負責。4 月 11 日 1:00 至 3:30，節目表把設計團隊安排在泳池現場的 Site walk。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。節目表 4 月 11 日 1:00 to 3:30 P.M. 的活動是 Site walk around the current pool with the design team，涵蓋她約 1:15 到 2:30 的到訪時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 公告只說紙本平面圖可以在 Westgate Library 查看，沒有說設計團隊會在那裡向居民說明，節目表也沒有這項安排。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷「某段時間依安排在做什麼」，先從一份文件找出確切時段，再到時間表找出涵蓋該時段的項目，並同時核對時段和參與者。若較晚發布的節目表更新了較早公告的安排，回答「排定的活動」時要以更新後的內容為準。

questions.prompt: In the notice, the phrase “go over” is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: our team will go over every response 指團隊會逐一仔細查看每一則意見，意思最接近 review。
explanation.reasoning_zh: go over 的受詞是 every response（每一則回覆），後面接著說五月中要分享 what we heard（聽到的意見）。可見團隊會先仔細閱讀、整理意見，再對外報告。go over 也有「超過」的意思，但放在這裡說不通。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: go over 接金額或限額時可以表示「超過」，例如 go over the budget；但「超過每一則意見」在這裡沒有意義。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 公告只說會看過意見，再在公開會議分享整體內容，沒有說要逐一回覆；go over 本身也沒有「回答」的意思。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 「轉寄」與 go over 的意思無關，公告也沒有提到要把意見轉交給其他人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。review every response（檢視每一則意見）符合上下文：先看過所有意見，再在公開會議分享聽到的內容。

evidence.quote: Once comments close, our team will go over every response, and in mid-May we will share what we heard

explanation.takeaway_zh: 片語動詞的意思要看受詞和上下文。go over 接文件或資料時常表示「仔細查看」，接金額或限制時則可能表示「超過」。

explanation.summary_zh: Okafor 女士先說明 4 月 11 日下午到工作室時沒見到設計團隊，接著提出主要請求 Would you or a colleague be willing to meet our committee before comments close?，並提出兩種會面地點。她寫信是為了安排會面、討論泳隊的具體問題，答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題要區分「促使寫信的經過」和「信件真正要達成的事」。在藝廊沒見到設計團隊，是寫信的起因。她接著說明問題很具體：新主池是否維持八條水道，以及更衣室能否應付三十名泳員在晨練前同時抵達。這些問題很難寫在意見卡上，所以她請對方在意見截止前與委員會見面，並提議可以再到工作室，或由泳隊在泳池接待。整封信的重點就是這個會面請求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中沒有說工作室提早關門。她們約 1:15 抵達、待到約 2:30，期間能在藝廊看模型、接待人員在場，也能填寫意見卡；問題只在於沒有設計團隊成員在場。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她寫 before comments close，是希望在意見截止之前見面，並沒有要求延後截止日期。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。請求句 Would you or a colleague be willing to meet our committee，加上兩個會面地點的提議，說明她寫信是為了安排會面，討論泳隊的問題。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她提議在泳池接待對方的時間是 any weekday evening after 7:00，用意是開會。泳隊每週四個早上訓練只是介紹泳隊的背景，early training 則用來說明更衣室的問題；信中沒有邀請對方觀看訓練。

we would be glad to host you at the pool on any weekday evening after 7:00

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找出信中的請求句（Would you...? / Could you...?），再判斷前面描述的經歷是起因還是目的本身。在先交代經過、再提出請求的信件中，請求通常才是寫信的目的。
